_doc: Test-only fixture for authz/engine.ts modelKey resolution (Layer 2 fallback shape). Loaded ONLY when AI_GATEWAY_CONFIG_ROOT points at test/fixtures/config-root (see test/setup-env.cjs, wired via npm test's --require preload). This directory is intentionally NOT shipped (test/ is excluded from package.json 'files'), so real consumers (e.g. Nexus, which has its own repo-root config/llm-config.json + data/llm-models-cache.json) are never shadowed by this fixture. Row shape: { id, provider, baseUrl?, apiKeyEnv?, active, type: 'API Key'|'Subscription' }. See authz/engine.ts _loadModels()/check() for resolution rules.
